policy_bundle.contract: Compile each material value or precedence from current inputs. Detect cycles, missing cases and unresolved amendments. Generated source-specific literals are permitted; global fixed policy knowledge is not.

turn_proposal.contract: No verified/success/permission authority fields accepted from extraction. Distinguish syntactic completion from exact normalization, target binding and backend truth.

fields: per-product component facts with opaque versions
state.contract: Opaque versions support equality, not integer freshness. Confirmed recorded promises are monotone; unknown effects survive ordinary dialogue updates.

fields: effect nodes with immutable semantic body and digest
plan.contract: Atomic local decision, serial external execution. Revalidate dependencies before each effect. A local body hash is not a bank acknowledgement. Do not add unsupported idempotency fields.

operation_journal.contract: Unknown dispatched action cannot become prepared by clearing vars. Retry is a fresh attempt of the same semantic request only after known no-effect and source budget.

scheduler.expression: Enabled = prerequisites satisfied AND not prohibited; schedule by source-derived strict partial order
scheduler.contract: No universal human>hardship>question ranking. Facts/questions persist while selecting the next action. Unordered conflicting effects require clarification or an explicit policy conflict.

obligations.title: Reduce all acts before action priority
obligations.formula: S1=Reduce(S0,TypeCheck(E)); Plan=Schedule(Enabled(P,S1)); no tool effect during Reduce
obligations.meaning: High-priority actions may suppress writes but cannot erase unrelated valid facts/questions. Preverification financial assertions remain quarantined, not a basis for disclosure or account ownership.

obligations.title: Partial-fact merge law
obligations.meaning: Expand target sets to individual products before merging. Distinct complete same-component values without correction edge mean conflict. Complete siblings satisfy matching unfinished needs; missing is not absent. A declared a->b correction is ordered and must not satisfy arbitrary permutation invariance.

obligations.title: Questions persist independently
obligations.formula: Question(q) => PendingAnswer(q) until sourced answer/explicit unknown/source-authorized termination
obligations.meaning: A source-specific question-as-decline rule such as A15 is phase scoped. Do not turn all questions into payment refusal. Account answers require verification/current API facts. An unfinished q is not automatically a complete request.

obligations.title: Identity, account and source-policy dependency
obligations.formula: G(FinancialWrite(p) => BankVerified(subject,identity_epoch) AND p in CurrentAccount(subject) AND compatible source policy/API)
obligations.meaning: Recipient confirmation and extraction completion never prove bank identity. Compile per-operation gates: callbacks and permitted preverification human transfers differ from financial writes. Security sequence derives from the current brief rather than a fixed global two-question path.

obligations.title: Product-specific valid complete terms
obligations.formula: G(Create(p,a,d) => complete/resolved(a,d,p) AND finite(a) AND AllowedAmount_P(p,a) AND AllowedDate_P(p,d,call_now))
obligations.meaning: Policy floor/deadline/calendar/adjustment rules use the returned product and call clock. Validate backend numeric fields too. Complete-but-vague expressions remain unresolved, not invented dates.

obligations.title: Readback dependency certificate
obligations.formula: C=(subject,account_epoch,policy_hash,API_hash,{p:amount_rev,date_rev,terms},readback_id,spoken_turn,consent_turn); Valid(C) => consent_turn>spoken_turn AND dependencies current AND no scoped withdrawal/correction
obligations.meaning: Changed or newly completed components invalidate old consent. Value reversion after a correction (ABA) cannot revive it. Joint-readback policy invalidates the joint batch when one included dependency changes. Scheduled speech is not an independently observed delivery acknowledgement.

obligations.title: Pause/withdrawal versus refusal
obligations.formula: Pause(p) => revoke applicable C, preserve facts(p), delta attempts(p)=0
obligations.meaning: Invalidating a joint certificate may affect all included writes but must not delete q refusal outside pause scope. Resume alone does not restore consent.

obligations.title: Typed, once-only counter consumption
obligations.formula: delta counter_c(p)=1 iff unique new event e satisfies source Predicate_c(e,p,stage)
obligations.meaning: Keep security declines, recipient asks, format clarification, per-product persuasion and stop events distinct. Valid new terms clear target deferred refusal; sibling completion cannot revive it. Count API errors/questions/ambiguity only if the source explicitly says so.

obligations.title: Bound operation receipts
obligations.formula: Apply(r,J) iff unique pending capsule matches operation, subject, body/product, attempt, dispatch epoch and receipt provenance; consumed(r) => no second application
obligations.meaning: Current mutable request_id is not response provenance. Require an immutable binding or a separately verified strict transport-order assumption; local serial equality alone cannot prove delayed/replayed-response safety.

obligations.title: Three-way outcome and retry
obligations.formula: Outcome(j) in {confirmed_success,confirmed_no_effect,unknown}; retry requires known no-effect AND budget AND unchanged body AND guard still valid
obligations.meaning: Current API500/ok:false explicitly guarantee no effect. Timeout/missing body/missing fields do not inherit this. Block blind unknown-outcome retry; retain same semantics and fresh attempt identity for permitted retry.

obligations.title: Atomic plan is not an atomic bank transaction
obligations.formula: freeze reduced state, dependencies and effect DAG; dispatch one effect; revalidate remainder after receipt
obligations.meaning: Preserve successful prefixes. Transfer cancels undispatched promises/prohibited notes, not successful past records. Never imitate rollback by deleting state.

obligations.title: Honest bank outcome
obligations.formula: Said(recorded,p) => confirmed_success(create,p); terminal=f_P(confirmed effects,known dispositions,unknown effects)
obligations.meaning: Intent, attempted call, transport success and bank effect are distinct. Failed note is not recorded note. Undefined failure/unknown terminal mapping is an unresolved obligation, not permission to invent enums or claim no_promise proves no record.

obligations.title: Last tool call and conditional liveness
obligations.formula: G(close_dispatched => no later bank call); count(close attempts)<=1; eventual safe terminalization => F(close_dispatched)
obligations.meaning: Separate at-most-once attempt from exactly-one successful close under tool failure/dropped calls. Farewell precedes close. Do not retry close blindly when source forbids another call.

obligations.title: No-note-on-transfer realizability
obligations.formula: Transfer in history => no AddNote anywhere in history
obligations.meaning: Deferral helps but cannot remove a successful note before a later mandatory transfer. If input may still arrive after note commit and API lacks compensation, these requirements may be jointly unrealizable. Prove a source-permitted finalization boundary or disclose the conflict.

obligations.title: Source-dependent graph flexibility
obligations.formula: Compile(P+amendment,API) satisfies effective source rules; undefined precedence/outcome blocks certification
obligations.meaning: Alpha-renamed codes, changed limits/calendars, security order and outcome priority must propagate across producer, decoder, guards and graph. A source rule list and empty conflicts array are not proof of coverage.

histories.title: Human-help detour preserves independent terms
histories.preconditions: Verified returned product p; valid symbols a,d; first human request; no write certificate.
histories.current_source_consequence: accumulate reconciles rows but does not persist product facts. Human branch485-489 selects the question before the product-update loop596-686, so new proposal values are not persisted on this path.
histories.required_behavior: O01: retain tentative validated facts, ask source-required help-first question; financial write remains disabled.

histories.preconditions: Verified p,q; a!=b are allowed p amounts; shared valid d; scopes{p,q} and{p}; no correction relation.
histories.current_source_consequence: accumulate groups by exact target-set tuple. Overlapping sets form different groups, so the later product loop can assign p twice. Final p amount follows row order instead of a per-product conflict.
histories.required_behavior: O02: expand target sets first; p amount becomes conflict, q retains a,d; clarify p and disable joint writes.

histories.title: Scoped withdrawal drops another product refusal
histories.preconditions: Verified p,q with spoken offers; current offer phase.
histories.current_source_consequence: Any complete consent row makes descriptive_pause true. Filter421 removes bare no/decline rows without target filtering; both events disappear, so question() occurs and q refusal is lost.
histories.required_behavior: O07/O08: revoke applicable certificate, preserve p terms with no p attempt spent, retain q refusal for source-permitted processing.
forbidden_calls: closing or noting refusal solely because p permission paused

histories.preconditions: Verified p; amount a complete; date unfinished; hardship complete.
histories.current_source_consequence: No complete proposal row exists, so branch556 applies. Because c0 exists,557 asks to finish; the persistent pending-component update605-627 is bypassed.
histories.required_behavior: O01/O02: retain a, mark only date unfinished, preserve hardship/no-persuasion obligations; do not treat partial row as no facts.

histories.title: Failed note marked noted
histories.preconditions: Verified p has non-promise disposition; matching local request serial; HTTP200/body ok:false reaches engine.
histories.current_source_consequence: Line378 sets noted=True before checking ok. Line379 sets note_failed, but finalization307-311 does not consult it; note loop skips the attempted but unrecorded product.
histories.required_behavior: O12: distinguish attempted/failed/confirmed note. Preserve disposition without certifying required note coverage. Recover or close only through an explicit source-backed failure rule.
allowed_next_calls: source-authorized recovery or honest unresolved-failure finalization

histories.title: Current API permits exact-body retry after proven no-effect
histories.preconditions: Verified complete terms and later joint consent; current-bound500; source retry budget available.
histories.current_source_consequence: Source includes matching-counter/status500 fallback318-323 and bounded retry375. It rechecks guards; exact body/receipt binding still require verification independent of control implementation.
histories.required_behavior: O09/O10: permitted retry has identical semantic body and a fresh attempt identity; acknowledge record only after success.
allowed_next_calls: one create_promise(p,a,d) within remaining source budget

histories.title: Unknown financial outcome cannot establish no-promise
histories.preconditions: Request dispatched; missing response with no current-bound documented500; bank commit unresolved.
history: DELIVERY unknown, possible backend commit not established
histories.current_source_consequence: Controller records unknown_write_outcome then exits. safe_close selects no_promise/service_error when no local status is recorded; this does not settle backend truth.
histories.required_behavior: O10/O12: preserve unknown, no blind retry or false recorded/no-record claim. API has no reconciliation endpoint/idempotency field/unknown outcome enum; terminal correctness in this environment remains uncertified.
allowed_next_calls: only source-supported best-effort finalization, with explicit unresolved outcome status in audit
forbidden_calls: claim that no promise exists in bank
histories.evidence_level: conditional transport countermodel; no hosted behavior observed

histories.title: Delayed response inherits newer local serial
histories.preconditions: Assume completed j1 for p, current same-operation j2 for q, and delayed duplicate j1 post-hook can occur.
history: HOOK writes current serial to api_receipt
histories.current_source_consequence: Post-hook copies mutable vars.request_id. Under the stated delivery assumption the local equality check can label j1 result as j2 and apply it to s.writing=q. Docs do not establish that this duplicate delivery is possible or impossible.

forbidden_calls: recording q based on p receipt

histories.required_behavior: O14: prove a policy-permitted closed finalization/input boundary, otherwise report jointly unrealizable history. No available call repairs both obligations.
allowed_next_calls: no call can undo this history under the current API

histories.preconditions: p confirmed recorded; transfer requested; transfer returns ok:false.

histories.preconditions: p readback uses revisions ra,rd; same user turn completes/corrects to ra2 and includes affirmative.
histories.current_source_consequence: Existing consent_terms blocks changed values and renegotiates; stored readback/consent are value tuples rather than explicit source/turn/revision certificates. This example is a required proof vector, not a claimed current write failure.
histories.required_behavior: O06: invalidate certificate, reduce correction, validate, read again, wait for later affirmative. ABA numeric equality cannot alone revive old consent.
histories.evidence_level: required regression vector; implementation outcome unexecuted

harness.contract: Every limit, enum, security step, failure class and precedence edge has source hash/span and effective override ancestry. Unknown/conflicting rules cannot acquire unreported defaults.

Generate source-grammar-valid events and require decoding to preserve typed meaning. Malformed/incomplete scopes must not become consent. Compare IR laws rather than mirroring literal implementation strings.

Permute/duplicate nonconflicting per-product patches and expand overlapping scopes before comparing final facts, obligations and permitted calls. No bank execution needed for the future reducer property harness.
Reverse a genuine correction edge and require the selected value to change. Remove the edge and require conflict. This rejects an overbroad row-permutation rule.

Add an independent administrative question: retain product facts/counters. Add transfer/withdrawal: enabled writes may shrink, but no success fact is invented and unrelated facts/questions are not lost.
Change only q deadline/refusal/amount: p recorded facts remain unchanged except documented joint consent dependencies. Preserve API order only where source policy depends on it.

Change amount/date revision, subject, product identity, policy or readback epoch: old write must be disabled. Revert value after correction: old certificate stays invalid. Same-turn new term is not later confirmation.
Inject stale/wrong-operation/wrong-body/replayed receipts and missing fields into a future symbolic harness. Apply a current effect at most once; unknown never becomes known-no-effect by default.
In separate synthetic API input remove HTTP500 no-effect guarantee; allowable retries must shrink. Change source retry budget; call count follows new limit. Do not edit official API/brief/scorer.

Symbolic two-product histories: success then no-effect, success then unknown, success then transfer success/failure. Check monotone bank facts, notes, speech and source outcome; expose undefined terminal cases.
Verify exported close nodes lead only to end with no later bank calls; analyze cycles and conditional liveness separately. API success, speech delivery and interruptions remain external assumptions.

Use separate synthetic sources to alpha-rename field/enums/product identifiers, reorder security steps, alter calendar/limits/outcome priority. Require corresponding producer/schema/guard/graph changes and unrelated semantic preservation. Never modify official expectations.
Search a symbolic history containing successful note then mandatory transfer. Either demonstrate a supported input-finalization boundary or report conflict; deferral alone is not a proof.

Spoof extracted verified/success/permission/raw-origin fields; they cannot establish backend evidence or trusted ingress. All emitted runtime operations remain within current bank API and fixed AGENT_LLM.

symbol_dictionary: p,q are returned identities, not customer fixtures; a,b distinct policy-valid amounts; d a valid date under call_now/calendar. No copied fixture constants are needed.

formal_limits.safety_proof: Base(S0) and each typed transition: invariant(S) AND stated environment assumptions => invariant(T(S,event)). Discharge source interpretation, extraction fidelity, receipt correlation, backend semantics and graph scheduling assumptions separately.
formal_limits.atomicity: Local atomic reduction and plan freezing do not make several bank API writes atomic. Preserve successful prefixes and record failed/unknown suffixes.
formal_limits.liveness: Arbitrary dropped calls, lost responses, unknown commits and post-note mandatory transfers prevent an unconditional successful-all-cases theorem under this API. State unsupported cases without changing official expectations.
formal_limits.frequency: All histories are symbolic source counterexamples/proof obligations. Candidate execution0; hosted frequency unmeasured; no full branch-coverage claim.
formal_limits.finalization: At-most-one close attempt is structurally different from exactly-one successful bank close. Unknown close response does not justify either a success claim or an extra forbidden attempt.

implementation_order: In a future automatic compiler rebuild, expand scopes to per-product patches, retain all typed facts/questions, then select source-prioritized actions. Keep producer and consumer schema paired.
Separate note/promise attempted, confirmed and unknown states; introduce immutable local request capsules and explicitly verify supported receipt ordering/correlation before asserting replay safety.
Bind provisional consent to product components, policy/account/source versions and an earlier readback; preserve confirmed records through failed later effects.

Generate source-specific outcome and retry tables, graph obligations and relational checks. Flag undefined failed-transfer, unknown-commit and post-note-transfer cases; do not invent policy or backend atomicity.
Keep implementation/data/model/guide/official kit unchanged in this checkpoint. No trained authority, GNN/GAN/GPU or external runtime service is needed to address these deterministic issues.
